presentation.label: DIFFUSED SPACE
presentation.summary: A compact diffused reverb with wet-output tone and modulation.
presentation.overview: Tone darkens or brightens the wet signal with one pole per stereo channel, while DAMP controls high-frequency decay inside the unchanged tank.
highlights: Independent tail damping and output tone
Mix in the lower-right slot; Tone above it
usage: Choose MINI VERB in FX2. DECAY and DAMP set the tail; TONE colors the wet output.
Turn TONE below 64 for darker reverb or above 64 for brighter reverb. At 64 the accepted voice is unchanged.
MOD and RATE add movement. MIX is now encoder F, below TONE; set MIX to 0 to bypass.

controls.name: TONE
controls.doc: wet color: 0 dark, 64 neutral, 127 bright; smoothed

controls.name: MOD
controls.doc: two in-loop allpasses; smoothed 0..64 sample depth

limitations: Stored projects, locks, scenes and LFO destinations use parameter slots: old MIX in slot C becomes TONE. Reassign Mix to slot F and set Tone to 64.
Physical hardware and power-cycle persistence remain untested; the owner explicitly waived hardware evidence for this exact update after accepting sound and stability in Octemu.
Cycle bounds use a static software model and inherited stock reserve; whole-instrument contention, maximum streaming/USB load and arbitrary companion FX are not measured.

storage.label: DSP program / buffer
storage.conditions: 532 assembled program words; unchanged 16K Y ring and 32-word X scalar allocation. Four additional scalar words use previously empty slots inside that block.

processing.label: DSP instruction peak
processing.conditions: Eight instances, four per core, at 44.1 kHz and 16-sample blocks; moving controls and mixed trigger splits. Executed instructions, not chip cycles or whole-instrument CPU.

impact.conditions: Eight FX2 instances, four per core; source-backed relative estimates, without whole-device utilization or silicon timing claims.

cpu.rationale: Existing stock parameter publication; no new ColdFire callback or runtime.

dsp.rationale: 411 modeled loop cycles/sample; 8,192 conservative modeled cycles/instance/block. Eight moving instances peak at 23,360 executed instructions/core/block.

memory.rationale: Existing 16K ring and X reservation unchanged; 402,936 logical bytes for eight instances including both programs and full hardware stack capacity.

tests.summary: 46 current-source native DSP regressions and real emulator LCD layout pass. Owner accepted sound and stability in Octemu and explicitly approved this release without physical hardware evidence. Software bounds and memory reservations are recorded in TESTING.md.
gates: verify.py: exact neutral and dry, endpoint spectra, eight-instance isolation, dirty-state guards and 30-second moving render
Native/browser composition parity and changed-original refusal

tutorial.title: Quick tutorial
steps: Select an audio track, hold FUNC and press FX2, then choose Mini Verb with LEVEL and YES.
Press FX2, turn encoder F (MIX) to 127, and compare encoder C (TONE) at 0, 64 and 127 while playing a sample.
Lower MIX to place the colored reverb behind the dry signal; set MIX to 0 to hear the exact dry signal and bypass the wet output.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: Mini Verb in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to Mini Verb and press YES to assign it.
Press FX2 to close SETUP; DECAY, DAMP and TONE are above MOD, RATE and MIX.
